name: uitest-monorepo
description: uitest-sdk and the products built on it

scripts.build: npm run build -w uitest-sdk && npm run build -w uitest-phone && npm run build -w uitest-console
scripts.test: npm run build -w uitest-sdk && vitest run test/unit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w uitest-sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.typecheck:tests: npm run build -w uitest-sdk && npm run typecheck:tests -ws --if-present
